title: 'Each player kills one of their gear' implemented as caster kills one target gear of any player
expected: Parser (riftbound-cards/src/parser/impl/effects-damage.ts:139-149) emits {type:"kill", player:"each", target:{type:"gear"}} for "Each player kills one of their gear." But the engine handler handle_kill (riftbound-engine/src/abilities/effects/kill.ts:8-29) never reads effect.player — it just calls getTargetIds(effect, ctx) and trashes those targets, i.e. a plain single-target kill on the caster-chosen target. Grep of the engine for `"each"` shows player:"each" fan-out is implemented only in draw.ts:10, discard.ts:18, channel.ts:13 (and grant-keyword) — not kill. Since the target descriptor {type:"gear"} carries no controller restriction, play-spell enumeration offers every gear on board (including opponent's), and resolution kills only that one card with no per-player choice. Matches observed behavior.
observed: Move enumeration offered playSpell targets = all gear on board incl. opponent's Gold token. Cast #1 (p1 has Seal of Rage + Sun Disc, p2 has Gold) targeting own Seal of Rage: only Seal of Rage went to trash; p2's Gold stayed in base, no prompt for p2. Cast #2 targeting p2's Gold: Gold was killed and p1's own Sun Disc survived. Chain item effect was {type:kill, player:each, target:{type:gear}} but resolved as single-target kill.
